synthesizedFacts.fact: Xerf is a non-invasive RF-based skin tightening system that uses monopolar radiofrequency and multifrequency energy to target multiple layers of the skin.
Xerf's technology stimulates collagen remodeling and elastin regeneration, resulting in firmer and smoother skin.
Xerf offers the world's first multifrequency monopolar RF treatment, combining 6.78 MHz and 2 MHz frequencies for deeper energy delivery.
Clinique Smart Clinical Repair products are clinically tested to visibly reduce lines and wrinkles.
